item.title: Everlast: Undying Tale
item.description:
Title: Everlast: Undying Tale
Genre: Action , Adventure , RPG , Early Access
Developer: InSpades
Publisher: InSpades
Release Date: Oct 28, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Oct 28, 2026




About This Game

We are Launching into Early Access on October 28th!

Everlast: Undying Tale is a love letter to MMO classics in an Action RPG Package.

  • MMO-Lite with 100 player servers

  • Skill based progression

  • Fantasy story and quests

  • Hand placed open world

  • Shared Events

Set out into a colorful fantasy world filled with unique areas, strange characters, and dangerous creatures. Build your character by using the skills you want to improve. Fight, gather, craft, fish, explore, collect loot, and put what you learn to use as the story unfolds. Play completely solo, privately with a few friends, or join a larger public world with up to 100 other players.

A STORYBOOK TALE
The rise of the undying, mysterious strangers with terrifying powers, tales of cowardice and heroics, and more than a few laughs await you on your journey through the world of Everlast: Undying Tale.

Play your part in stopping the surge of undying through deeds, both small and mighty. Reveal the secrets of the world, and of your newfound curse, from a memorable cast of characters. Convene with the dead, track down arcane items for friendly monsters, or help townsfolk with simple tasks in the daily lives of running their farms and shops.

Discover the magic of a brightly themed, yet slightly macabre adventure that spans from one corner of the world to the next.

EXPLORE A BRIGHT OPEN WORLD
Discover a vast and bright fantasy realm featuring a variety of landscapes to explore.
From the bustling capital of Kal Crossing to the dismal Southern Swamps, across the depths of the Abyss to the top of a great mountain at the center of a dense forest, there are hidden places and points of interest that will help you on your journey. Take your time, wander off the beaten path, and find new ways to grow.

MASTER YOUR SKILLS
Progress your character through leveling skills such as woodworking, occultism, fishing, and much more. Our Character progression is largely inspired by classic MMO games, but we've ensured that progress in our game occurs much more quickly, allowing you to see clear results in your progress every time you login and play. Use the skills you master to improve your gear and more effectively gather resources, engage in combat, and progress through the story.

SHARED DYNAMIC EVENTS
Work together for special events and tasks, and to help breathe life back into a world that has fallen into ruin.


Ranging from massive harvests to epic battles, our server wide events allow for everyone to contribute as much or as little as they want. These events are player activated and will display as shared events on the in-game map and quest tracker.


Additionally, we have a different set of server wide events that anyone can contribute to at any time. These are called "Desolate Zones" and repairing them will help to rebuild the world that you are playing on permanently. This offers benefits back to the player such as ideal depositing or gathering locations, services such as cooking or crafting, or making the world easier to traverse.

LOVINGLY CRAFTED
Everlast: Undying Tale is built from the ground up by a small, passionate team of engineers, artists, and musicians. This is the first game from our studio, and we have poured our hearts into bringing it from a distant dream to a vibrant reality. We hope that love and care shines through in every moment, both big and small.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content



System Requirements

Windows

MacOS

Linux

item.title: President Simulator
item.description:
Title: President Simulator
Genre: Simulation , Early Access
Developer: Studio 14b
Publisher: Studio 14b
Release Date: Oct 28, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Oct 28, 2026




About This Game

Welcome to the Oval Office. Settle in, put your feet on the desk, and get ready to ruin the country... or save it by accident.

In this satirical political simulator, competence is optional, but chaos is guaranteed. You have the power, the pen, and above all, the Big Red Button. What could possibly go wrong?

On your agenda:

  • Extreme Legislator: Sign, stamp, or bin totally wacky decrees. Legalize socks with sandals? Why not. Consequences are a problem for later.

  • Crisis Management by Guesswork: You don't need to actually understand an issue to manage it.

  • Double-Speak 2.0: Shine during press conferences. When a journalist asks "Why?", answer with an inspiring speech that means absolutely nothing.

  • Total Tactile Immersion: It's your office. Throw decrees, shove your advisors. You are the President, nobody’s going to stop you.

  • The Red Button: It’s there. It’s glowing. It’s tempting. Press it. Go on. Just to see what happens.

  • From Ruins to Glory: Cracked walls, cobwebs, planks on the windows... your predecessor left quite a mess. Clean it up and restore the Oval Office to its former glory. You've earned it.

  • Cabinet of "Yes-Men": Recruit advisors who will execute your most absurd decisions. They are here to serve, not to think.

  • Political Roulette: Watch your actions succeed (or fail miserably). Politics is just like a casino, after all.

  • The Art of Balance (or lack thereof): Going all-in on the military won't save you when the economy collapses. Try to juggle, or face the consequences.

  • Gotcha Interviews: Journalists have memories like elephants. They will grill you on your past actions: let's hope you remember what you signed this morning, because you'll have to justify it live.

  • The Power Meter: Gain popularity to unlock more power. The more the people love you, the more you can get away with... without (too many) consequences.

    • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10

    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 5 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
    • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 480
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 5 GB available space

item.title: A Place for Every Potion
item.description:
Title: A Place for Every Potion
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: CubeQuad Games
Publisher: CubeQuad Games
Release Date: Oct 28, 2026




About This Game

Your grandfather's new auto-sorting spell backfired.

Every potion in the apothecary tipped off its shelf. Every finished potion unravelled back into raw essence, and the loose colors pooled together in one enormous pile in the middle of the lab.

He chuckled. "Ah, it does that sometimes." Then he pulled on his coat for the annual Alchemists Gathering and asked you to mind the place while he is away.

He'll be gone about a month. There is no rush at all.

Two puzzles

Every potion needs two things done to it.

Decant. Pour the scrambled liquids from bottle to bottle until each one holds a single pure color. If you have ever played a water-sort puzzle, your hands already know this part.

Shelve. Carry the finished potion across the lab to the shelf it belongs on. Color gets you to the right wall. The sigil on its label picks the exact shelf.

You can only levitate a few bottles at a time, so the two puzzles compete for the same hands. Pour greedily and you have nothing free to carry with. Carry too much and you have nothing free to pour into. Deciding what to hold is the game.

One laboratory. 4,160 potions.

A gothic stone rotunda, two floors, tall arched windows and warm afternoon light. 52 shelved sections across thirteen families of potion.

Every one of the 4,160 potions is in that pile from the moment you start. Nothing respawns, nothing refills, nothing quietly re-stirs itself behind your back. The mess only ever gets smaller.

The room is the progress bar. The floor clears. The shelves fill and light up. A dark, dusty laboratory slowly becomes a glowing apothecary.

Relaxing is the whole point

No timers. No pressure. No penalties. No fail state. There is nothing here you can lose.

Warm window light, a quiet score, and the sound of glass and liquid. Put a potion on the wrong shelf and nothing scolds you. No buzzer, no shake, nothing taken away. Set a bottle down mid-pour, walk off, and come back next week to exactly where you left it.

Skills make the work easier. They never make it disappear.

Sorting earns XP, XP earns levels, and every level buys a skill point. There are 47 of them, across a board of 24 nodes.

A wider hand. A longer reach. Deeper buffers to work into, and sight that pulls a workable set out of the pile.

What none of them do is play for you. Nothing pours, carries or shelves on your behalf, and nothing sits on a cooldown. You get better tools and a bigger workspace. The satisfying part stays yours.

Three numbers, counted all the way down

52 sections. 364 shelf rows. 4,160 potions.

The game keeps all three counters and you can switch them on or off. No hidden progress and no rounding. Every potion you finish and shelve moves a number you can watch.

The lab is done when the pile is gone and all 52 cabinets are full. A finite game with a real ending, not a loop that farms you.

Features

  • Two interlocking puzzles: water-sort decanting and tidy-up shelving

  • 4,160 potions across 52 sections and 364 shelf rows, in one continuous laboratory of 2 floors

  • No fail state, no timers, no penalties

  • A 24-node skill board that hands you better tools and never plays for you

  • Full input rebinding, an FOV slider, and a HUD you can switch off

  • Autosaves after every pour and every placement

  • Unlike the free mobile versions of this genre: buy it once. No ads, no energy timers, no shop, no dark patterns.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

I am a solo developer with ten years of experience, who started out as a 3D artist.

Every piece of 3D art in this game was made by me: the models, the UVs, the LODs. All of the game code and architecture was designed and programmed by me.

I used AI to assist me with some of the textures and the music.

This is a solo project with no funding and I wanted it to follow my vision so I needed any help I could get. If I ever could afford to hire people, that is what I am going to do, so we can deliver even better quality games!

[UPDATE]
Since many players requested, I replaced the AI music with human-made music. And one nice freelancer volunteered to help with textures. Not sure if we can make it until the release though but will try!



System Requirements

Windows

MacOS

item.title: Airport Contraband
item.description:
Title: Airport Contraband
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: DRAGO entertainment
Publisher: DRAGO entertainment , Shochiku
Release Date: Oct 28, 2026




About This Game

WELCOME TO CALDORA AIRPORT

In Airport Contraband , you step into the role of a customs officer at Caldora Airport – a place where the line between duty and greed has never been thinner. Your task is to keep everything under control while making sure no contraband slips through your fingers. Verify documents, inspect passengers, search luggage, and scan cargo to uncover prohibited goods.

Or break the law, and look for ways to earn some easy money. Let the smugglers through and arrest those who are innocent. Turn a blind eye to contraband and work with the local cartel to gain profit in the blink of an eye. At the end of the day, it’s all about finding the sweetest spot that benefits you the most.

ROGUELIKE MEETS SIMULATION

Each day brings new choices. Follow official security procedures or take risky jobs for the cartel. Success earns rewards and upgrades that carry over to your next officer, shaping how you play over time. Every shift is a fresh start built on past decisions, where experience, tools, and mistakes define your future at Caldora Airport.

OBEY THE RULES...

Follow daily procedures, verify documents, inspect cargo, and search for hidden goods. Every correct decision earns trust and keeps the chaos of Caldora at bay.

OR BEND THEM

Not everyone here plays by the book, including you. Transfer something off the record, or let potential smugglers and restricted items through. Quick money comes easily, but it always comes with a risk.

TRUST NO ONE

Whether you are dealing with pesky passengers or stubborn pilots, no one is above inspection. Check pilots’ papers, inspect their cargo, weigh it, and compare it with the documents. You will be surprised how much contraband slips under your nose.

HOLD THE LINE

Sometimes life at Caldora Airport is not that simple. Some suspects will not cooperate, and others will do anything to slip away. When things get out of control, your taser and handcuffs might be your last resort.

SCIENCE WON'T FAIL YOU

As you gain experience, so do smugglers. That is when science comes in. Perform chemical tests, scan luggage with X-rays to spot hidden items, and rely on your good old instincts to detect those who try to deceive you. Acquire new tools such as knives, UV lamps, hammers, and crowbars to help you uncover contraband with ease. It is always better to be safe than sorry.

System Requirements

Windows

    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 960 4GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 10 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 (recent generation)
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 or better 6GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 15 GB available space

item.description:
Title: Fantasy World Manager
Genre: Indie , RPG , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: Florian Alushaj
Publisher: Legendary Pixels
Release Date: Oct 28, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Oct 28, 2026




About This Game

Fantasy World Manager is the ultimate, gamified tool for creating, simulating, and observing living fantasy worlds.

Build a fantasy world on a massive scale

...and watch it come to life!

Create unique places!

...where heroes go on adventures!

...and fight epic battles!

..to seize control!

Use a variety of editors to shape the world according to your rules!

...and much more!
